==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gundark_Trainer.jpg|thumb|200px|''Gundark Trainer'', a video game]]
[[Roan Novachez]], a student at the [[Jedi academy]] within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], enjoyed playing video games with his friends. He often played them with [[Pasha]].<ref name="return">''[[Jedi Academy: Return of the Padawan]]''</ref>

After Roan began spending time with the bullies [[Cronah]] and [[Cyrus (Jedi Academy)|Cyrus]], he began playing video games with them that were much more violent than the ones he usually played with Pasha, such as ''[[Gundark Trainer]]''.<ref name="return" />

[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] enjoyed playing video games and sometimes left [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] to do his dirty work while he finished a level.<ref name="secret">''[[LEGO Star Wars: Vader's Secret Missions]]''</ref>

While the universe of ''[[Star Wars]]'' has been featured in a number of [[:Category:Computer and video games|computer and video games]], ''Return of the Padawan'' marks the first time of their appearing as part of the story, albeit in a non-[[canon]]ical fashion. Author and artist [[Jeffrey Brown]] created ''Gundark Trainer'' for ''Return of the Padawan'', though the final artwork featured a screenshot from the game, rather than the game's title.<ref name="interview">[[Wookieepedia:Interview/Jeffrey Brown|Interview with Jeffrey Brown]]</ref>
